steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓Which sprite’s view can you see on the screen?

❓ Which sprite should the camera follow around the screen?


Solution: 

Sprite name in the [camera follow sprite] block should be changed to bunny.
steps.instructions:
When you move the Bunny sprite off the screen, you can’t see where it moves to! 


Fix the bugs in the code so that the camera follows the Bunny sprite wherever it moves on the tilemap.

subgroups.introduction:
Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!


Fix the bugs in the code so that the Player sprite can move around the screen to collect different sprites, while avoiding the Enemy sprite!

validationItems.failureText: Check the sprite name in the [camera follow sprite] block.

steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ Why do you think each of the sprites are appearing on top of each other, when the game starts?

❓ How can you change where each sprite appears on the screen?
